summary: Huntingdon County, PA tree observation tower from 1907, still used about 1917 per FFLOS; no longer standing. The nearby Stone Mountain Hawk Watch is not tied to it.

facts.design: tree tower; a tree observation post about 40 feet above the ground (Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: FFLOS says it is no longer standing; no removal date found

access.note: The Stone Mountain Hawk Watch overlook is on the mountain, with parking at the top; no source ties the former tower site to it, and none describes the site today

events.note: FFLOS: tree tower built in 1907; Forest Lookouts: tree observation post established in 1907
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: built 1907, still used circa 1917, no longer standing
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1907, was still used circa 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: the FFLOS record gives no coordinates
1907 tree observation post about 40 feet above the ground, established
evidence.quote: 1907: A tree observation post 40 feet above the ground was established.

evidence.supports: Stone Mountain Hawk Watch is in Rothrock State Forest on the Huntingdon and Mifflin county line
evidence.quote: located deep in Rothrock State Forest along the Huntingdon County and Mifflin County line

evidence.supports: parking area at the top of Stone Mountain
evidence.quote: The parking area is located at the top of Stone Mountain

evidence.supports: overlook is most popular in autumn for migrating hawks
evidence.quote: most popular during the autumn for watching for migrating hawks

corrections.why: The FFLOS record describes the structure as a tree tower built in 1907

sources.title: Visiting Stone Mountain Hawk Watch in Rothrock State Forest

notes_for_editor: FFLOS and Forest Lookouts agree on 1907 (FFLOS calls it a built tree tower; Forest Lookouts an observation post). The brief's coordinates 40.54841, -77.84297 have no source (FFLOS says none are available), and they sit about 2.5 km from the hawk-watch parking at 40.568986, -77.828596 (Uncovering PA). Nothing links the old tower to the hawk watch. No staffing, fire or removal-date evidence found. A Library of Congress catalog record for the Daily New Era (1907-1916) was seen but not used.
